capabilities: copy the vault file behind a wikilink, embed, or markdown link to the clipboard
resolve local file:/// URLs and copy the target file
copy files from a right-click menu in the file explorer
paste copied files into File Explorer, email, chat apps, or upload controls
disambiguation: Copies the file itself as a clipboard file drop list, not the link text or URL.
extras: Desktop-only and Windows-only; uses Node.js and Windows clipboard APIs, so macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android are not supported. README states no network requests, telemetry, or note modifications.
problem: Obsidian's copy actions work on link text or paths, so getting the real underlying file into File Explorer, email, or chat apps requires finding it manually.

relations.evidence: Invokes Windows PowerShell locally to write the file path into the system clipboard

summary: Windows-only plugin that copies the actual file behind an internal link, embed, file:/// URL, or file menu item to the Windows clipboard.
